rows.grounds: temporal adverb indicating the state described
demonstrative pronoun referring to the subject
embodiment of divine energy and siddhi
negated compound denying otherness; fused form kept as one token
denotes a second entity, here negated in sense

items.question: What singular non-dual status is affirmed of the yoginī in that state?
premises: In that state the yoginī is declared one.
The yoginī is explicitly described as not other.
No second entity is admitted alongside the yoginī.
items.inference: Therefore the yoginī abides as a singular reality without a second.
uncertainties: The gender shift between yoginī and masculine predicates may reflect archaic usage or agreement with an implied subject.
items.plain_english: Then that yoginī is indeed one, not other; there is truly no second.
